scope: Promote index-level events ranked 41-100 to editorial level and extend the battle layer for Oceania, South Asia and Southeast Asia.

events.idRule: id stays v312wd-<qid>; the provenance field is removed entirely and wikidataQid is kept

civilYears.policy: Wikidata P585 is ISO 8601 astronomical (year zero exists); the project uses civil years without a year zero, so iso<=0 ships as iso-1.

excluded.reason: Wikidata P585 records 2020 while the English and Chinese Wikipedia articles date the fighting from 2022; the battle layer inherits 2020, so an editorial entry with the sourced year would break cross-layer consistency and one with 2020 would enshrine a wrong date.
Wikidata P585 records 2020 while both Wikipedia articles date the battle to 2022; the same conflict as Q111383245 applies.

crossLayer.limitation: The check only compares the two layers with each other. Two layers can agree on a year that both sources contradict, which is exactly how Q111383245 and Q112206624 stayed hidden until the Wikipedia articles were read by hand.

Belligerents and conflicts stay arrays of source strings and are never invented
English fields contain Latin script only and Chinese fields are present
Every battle cites its Wikidata entity and any statement reference
Layer metadata records the selection policy and drop counts
The layer does not duplicate ids or coordinates of existing place datasets
